<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex66042024-09-1615-06-08" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">rnyed dka'i sky* 'byor mi lus kyi ||
            snying po len pa'i thabs kyi mchog gyur pa ||
            byang chub sems gnyis spyod tshul lung rigs la ||
         brten nas <lb n="81a4"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4221">kyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs</rs> kyis bshad ||
         dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems bskyed de ||
            byang chub spyod pa'i tshul la legs zhugs pas ||
            tshogs gnyis rgyu chen rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas || sku gsum nor bu'i dpal la spyod par shog ||</seg></TEI>
